title: Integration against μ = θ H^n⌞M
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, H := μHE[n] on ℝ^N, and let μ be a Borel measure on ℝ^N. Let M ⊆ ℝ^N be H-null-measurable, and let θ : ℝ^N → ℝ with θ > 0 on M and θ H-integrable on M ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^N. Suppose μ(B) = ∫⁻_{M∩B} ofReal(θ) dH for every Borel B. Then for every function g : ℝ^N → ℝ, ∫ g dμ = ∫_M g·θ dH (Bochner integrals, with Lean's convention for non-integrable functions).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ), NullMeasurableSet M μHE[n] → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x) → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) μHE[n]) → (∀ B : Set (Euclidean N), MeasurableSet B → μ B = ∫⁻ x in M ∩ B, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n]) → ∀ g : Euclidean N → ℝ, ∫ z, g z ∂μ = ∫ z in M, g z * θ z ∂μHE[n]
